rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for promising or assuring something and for saying that an outcome is certain.

example.english: I guarantee I can hand in the report tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我保證聽日交到份報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou2 zing3 ting1 jat6 gaau1 dou2 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an assurance that something will happen or be true.

example.english: There’s no guarantee this offer won’t be cancelled at any time.
example.traditional: 呢個優惠冇保證，可能隨時取消。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau1 wai6 mou5 bou2 zing3 ho2 nang4 ceoi4 si4 ceoi2 siu1

rows.note: Use this specifically when taking responsibility for someone else’s debt or obligation.

example.english: I guarantee your debt, so you don’t need to worry.
example.traditional: 我擔保你筆數，你唔使驚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daam1 bou2 nei5 bat1 sou3 nei5 m4 sai2 geng1

rows.note: Use this for a product warranty, especially when discussing repair or coverage during the warranty period.

example.english: The two-year guarantee on this phone lets you take it back for repair if it breaks.
example.traditional: 呢部手機有兩年保養，壞咗可以拎返去整。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jau5 loeng5 nin4 bou2 joeng5 waai6 zo2 ho2 ji5 ling1 faan1 heoi3 zing2

rows.note: Use this for a formal or legal guarantee securing an obligation or debt.

example.english: The bank provides a guarantee for this debt.
example.traditional: 銀行為呢項債務提供擔保。
example.jyutping: ngan4 hong4 wai6 ni1 hong6 zaai3 mou6 tai4 gung1 daam1 bou2
